classification: outcome-aware comparator strengthening on exact moments; no sampled trajectory and no formal evidence

static_optimizer.parameterization: one arbitrary row-stochastic 4-by-4 matrix reused at all six decision blocks
static_optimizer.solver: deterministic 10-start SLSQP including identity, uniform, three shrinkages, three permutations, the best discrete graph, and its smoothed version
static_optimizer.claim_boundary: strong best-found continuous static comparator; no unsupported global-optimality claim

dynamic_oracle.class: exact next-block row-simplex risk minimizer with charged local-shadow rollback
dynamic_oracle.solver: enumerate all nonempty row supports and solve each equality-constrained convex quadratic
dynamic_oracle.role: outcome-aware architecture ceiling, not a deployable controller

analysis.primary_metric: geometric mean of dynamic-continuous to optimized-static-continuous cumulative-risk ratios

mandatory_gates.H1: all 432 cells complete, finite, and positive
mandatory_gates.H2: replayed discrete static risk matches the frozen source within relative error 1e-10
mandatory_gates.H3: the optimized continuous static comparator is no worse than the source discrete static comparator in every cell
mandatory_gates.H4: at least one successful static start per cell, row-sum residual at most 1e-9, and no negative weight below -1e-12
mandatory_gates.H5: dynamic oracle uses exactly 240 learning transitions, zero extra probes, and at most 18 message units
mandatory_gates.H6: maximum exact row-simplex KKT residual at most 1e-7
mandatory_gates.H7: dynamic continuous oracle improves aggregate nonstationary risk by at least 5 percent over the strengthened continuous static graph
mandatory_gates.H8: strict dynamic improvement in at least 60 percent of nonstationary cells
mandatory_gates.H9: single-switch and alternating schedules each improve by at least 3 percent
mandatory_gates.H10: every delay group has nonnegative improvement
mandatory_gates.H11: stationary dynamic improvement is at most 5 percent
mandatory_gates.H12: the dynamic graph changes at least once in at least 60 percent of nonstationary cells
mandatory_gates.H13: clean rerun cells and scientific summary are byte-identical
